title.zh: ASPIRE：尝试、诊断、改进并复用
title.en: ASPIRE: try, diagnose, improve and reuse

blocks.zh: ASPIRE 是 NVIDIA 开源的机器人技能发现框架。它让智能体编写和改进控制程序，查看执行记录，定位失败，再通过重试检验修改。通过验证的经验被整理成可复用技能，帮助后续任务。这里的主要学习对象是程序和技能经验；这与 GR00T 通过训练更新神经网络参数不同。
blocks.en: ASPIRE is NVIDIA’s open robot-skill discovery framework. An agent writes and revises control programs, inspects execution traces, diagnoses failure and tests repairs. Validated experience becomes reusable skills for later tasks. This improves programs and skill knowledge, unlike GR00T training that updates neural parameters.

blocks.label: 执行结果决定哪些经验值得保留
nodes: 调用已有感知与动作工具
保留可重复成功的技能
details: 例如先观察，再调用短距离接近，最后检查球的位置。程序必须使用执行端真实提供的工具，而不是臆造一个“必定射门成功”的接口。
保留每次工具调用前后的观察，才能把“要求转向”和“身体实际转了多少”联系起来。仿真允许在明确的范围内反复试验。
如果球已经进门但机器人继续向前，应该检查制动与完成条件；反复调用视觉检测未必解决问题。修改应有具体假设。
在没有用于修补程序的新起点上检验，再保存适用条件、调用方法与恢复经验。记住一次成功的参数，不等于获得通用技能。

english_diagram.label: Execution results determine which experience to retain
details: For example: observe, request a short approach, then check ball position. Programs must use real execution tools, not an imaginary always-successful shot command.
Record observations around tool calls to connect requested turning to actual movement. Simulation enables repeated, bounded experimentation.
If the ball scores but the robot keeps moving, investigate braking and termination; more detection calls may not help. Each repair needs a specific hypothesis.
Evaluate on starts not used for repairs, then retain applicability, usage and recovery guidance. Remembering one successful parameter set is not a general skill.

blocks.zh: 沿箭头阅读，点击模块查看解释。
blocks.en: Follow the arrows and select modules for explanations.

blocks.zh: 对 Microduck，先在同一个简单球场验证观察、短距离移动、受控停车和结果判断，再组成完整射门。智能体推理或等待网络时，底层平衡控制仍要运行。更换场地与更长任务，应建立在这些基础能力可靠之后。
blocks.en: For Microduck, first validate observation, short movements, controlled stopping and outcome checks on the same simple field, then compose a complete shot. Balancing continues while the agent reasons or waits for network responses. New environments and longer tasks build on those reliable capabilities.

title.zh: GR00T 与 ASPIRE 怎样配合

zh: 调用什么能力，如何检查和改进
观察球偏向一侧，选择重定位后再试
给定观察，下一段怎样动作
根据图像与状态生成接近或碰球动作
怎样及时而稳定地执行
维持平衡、限幅、制动与动作超时处理
en: What to invoke, check and improve
Choose to reposition after observing an offset ball
How to execute promptly and stably

blocks.zh: 这个分层设计允许逐步替换能力，而不必一次让大模型接管所有关节。大模型也不会自动消除坐标、时间和单位问题；这些细节应封装在清晰的工具接口里，让智能体可以组合使用。
blocks.en: This hierarchy allows gradual replacement of capabilities without giving a large model every joint at once. Coordinates, timing and units still matter; clear tool interfaces encapsulate those details so the agent can compose them.

title.zh: 扩展阅读：Agnes Harness

blocks.zh: Agnes Harness 也围绕模型、工具与执行反馈组织机器人任务，其设备接入与插件设计值得作为扩展阅读。阅读这类框架时，可以比较三个问题：工具如何连接机器人，执行结果如何返回，失败经验怎样复用。比较时，重点观察两种框架怎样把执行反馈转化为可复用的能力。
blocks.en: Agnes Harness also organizes robot tasks around models, tools and feedback. Its device integration and plugin design are useful further reading. Compare how tools connect to robots, how results return and how failures inform reuse. ASPIRE supplies this chapter’s main skill-discovery methodology.

question.zh: 让智能体不停尝试，是否就等于机器人能力会持续提高？
question.en: Does unlimited retrying guarantee improving capability?

answer.zh: 不等于。需要可靠的动作工具、可诊断的反馈、有限的尝试预算，以及未参与修补的新测试。只有能重复验证的改进，才适合保留为技能。
answer.en: No. It needs reliable tools, diagnostic feedback, bounded attempts and tests excluded from repairs. Keep improvements that reproduce under evaluation.

title.zh: 从一个球场走向更多环境
title.en: From one field to more environments

summary.zh: 先判断失败来自哪里，再选择纠正示范、物理校准或 Cosmos 3 数据扩展；逐步检验新环境中的泛化。
summary.en: Diagnose failures before choosing corrections, physics calibration or Cosmos 3 data expansion; evaluate generalization step by step.

meta.zh: 第 9 章 · 预计学习时长 25 分钟

title.zh: 先把一个场景做可靠

blocks.zh: 先固定一种足球场地垫、背景与道具，让传统方案成为可靠基线，再检验 GR00T 的独立执行和 ASPIRE 的技能组织。这个顺序让问题容易解释：如果连原场景都不能稳定完成，增加十种房间通常只会让失败更难定位。
blocks.en: Fix one mat, background and set of props. Establish a reliable traditional baseline, then evaluate independent GR00T execution and ASPIRE skill organization. This order makes failures interpretable: if the original scene is unreliable, adding ten rooms usually makes diagnosis harder.

blocks.zh: 当同场景的新起点、轻微球位偏差和完整停车都已能稳定处理，再问“换一个家还能不能用”。不同家庭的光线、背景、布局和地面确实会变化，但不必一次把所有因素加入训练。
blocks.en: After reliable handling of fresh starts, modest ball offsets and complete stopping on one field, ask whether the system transfers to another home. Lighting, background, layout and surfaces do vary, but training need not change every factor at once.

title.zh: 先分清外观问题与动作问题

zh: 视觉数据覆盖与外观随机化
把球门材质随机化就能解决一切
看见球，却从侧面越走越偏
多生成背景图就能学会恢复
球进门，但机器人停不住
制动控制、动力学与时延校准
图像更真实就能自动停稳
家具挡路，原路线不可用
布局变化与可执行的避障技能
只换地面贴图就能学会导航
en: Ball is missed under new light
Random goal materials fix every failure
Ball is seen but approach drifts
Ball scores but robot cannot stop

blocks.zh: 域随机化（Domain Randomization）是在训练时改变选定条件，让模型减少对单一环境的依赖。外观随机化改变看到的样子，动力学随机化改变真实运动，两者要分别设计。门框材质保持固定；地面扩展可先考虑两种足球场图案、大理石与棕色木地板。
blocks.en: Domain randomization changes selected training conditions to reduce dependence on one environment. Appearance variation changes images; dynamics variation changes motion. Design them separately. Keep goal-frame material fixed; possible floor expansion includes two football patterns, marble and brown wood.

title.zh: Cosmos 3：为同一动作补充视觉变化
title.en: Cosmos 3: visual variation for an action sequence

blocks.zh: Cosmos 3 是可用于理解和生成世界相关数据的多模态模型家族。对本任务，一个适合研究的入口是 video transfer：以已有仿真视频为基础，用边缘、深度或分割等条件约束内容，生成不同光照与室内外观的候选视频。
blocks.en: Cosmos 3 is an omnimodal family for understanding and generating world-related data. One relevant research path is video transfer: use existing simulation video with controls such as edges, depth or segmentation to generate candidate lighting and interior variations.

blocks.label: 改变视觉外观，检查动作标签是否仍然成立
nodes: 生成受条件约束的外观
陌生环境中的自主成功
details: 源数据首先要有正确动作和时间对应关系。原示范没有教会停车，改变它的外观也不会补出停车技能。
用结构条件帮助保持布局，再改变光照或房间外观。生成是候选数据生产过程，条件约束并不保证每一帧都正确。
检查球大小、门柱位置、机器人形状、接触时刻与跨帧连续性。如果球被生成到脚的另一侧，原动作标签就可能不再适用，应拒绝这段数据。
在相同示范量与训练预算下，与不增加生成数据的策略比较。把新房间或新组合留给测试，才能判断扩展是否有帮助。

english_diagram.label: Vary appearance and check whether action labels remain valid
details: Source data need correct actions and timing. Restyling a demonstration without braking skill does not add that skill.
Structural controls help preserve layout while appearance changes. Outputs remain candidates: conditioning does not guarantee every frame is correct.
Inspect ball scale, posts, robot shape, contact time and temporal continuity. If a ball moves to the other side of a foot, the old action label may be invalid; reject the segment.
Compare against training without generated data under matched data and compute budgets. Hold out rooms or combinations to evaluate the benefit.

blocks.zh: 沿箭头阅读，点击模块查看解释。
blocks.en: Follow the arrows and select modules for explanations.

blocks.zh: 生成视频不是一次新的物理实验。更漂亮的进球画面不能证明动作可执行；可靠性仍要回到闭环仿真，以及之后的真机测试。涉及摩擦、质量或制动距离的变化，要用物理参数与实测来处理。
blocks.en: Generated video is not a new physics experiment. A prettier goal does not establish executable actions; reliability still needs closed-loop simulation and later hardware tests. Friction, mass and braking-distance changes require physics parameters and measurements.

title.zh: 扩展到机器人、场景与任务组合

blocks.zh: Isaac Lab-Arena 将环境分成 Scene（场景）、Embodiment（机器人、传感器与动作）和 Task（目标与完成判据），便于组合评测与数据采集。Isaac Lab 组织学习环境，Newton 推进物理，渲染器产生图像；OSMO 可以编排数据生成、训练与评测等计算工作流。
blocks.en: Isaac Lab-Arena separates Scene, Embodiment (robot, sensors and actions), and Task (goals and completion criteria) for compositional evaluation and data collection. Isaac Lab organizes learning environments, Newton advances physics and a renderer produces images. OSMO can orchestrate data generation, training and evaluation workflows.

blocks.zh: 组合不是任意拼接：机器人必须具备任务需要的传感器和动作，评测标准也要明确。步行与轮滑属于同一 Microduck 的两种模式，应分别评测；多环境同时运行，也不等于已经训练出能控制所有机器人的统一模型。
blocks.en: Combinations require compatible sensors, actions and clear evaluation criteria. Walking and skating are two modes of one Microduck, evaluated separately. Running environments concurrently does not itself produce one policy controlling every robot.

blocks.zh:
试着规划一组评测

这只是组合计数器，不启动仿真或训练。取消一项表示固定为一种条件。
blocks.en:
Design an evaluation matrix

This only counts combinations; it launches no simulation or training. Unchecking a factor fixes it to one condition.

title.zh: 逐步扩大，而不是一次全随机
title.en: Expand one factor at a time

blocks.zh: 一个合理顺序是：同一球场稳定完成 → 少量光照变化 → 新地面外观 → 新室内布局 → 有测量依据的动力学变化。每一步保留前一步作为对照，用同样的完整成功判据比较。若新变化带来的主要失败是看不清，就补视觉覆盖；若是走偏或停不稳，就回到纠正示范或控制与校准。
blocks.en: A useful progression is: stable completion on one field → modest lighting variation → new floor appearance → new room layouts → measured dynamics variation. Keep the previous stage as a baseline with the same complete-success criteria. Add visual coverage for perception failures, or revisit corrections and control calibration for drift and braking.

question.zh: 同一组动作的视频换了十种背景，就等于获得十倍不同的动作经验吗？
question.en: Do ten restyled backgrounds provide ten times the action experience?

answer.zh: 不等于。它扩充了视觉条件，但动作和状态覆盖可能仍相同。恢复偏差、改变路线或适应制动，需要对应的新轨迹或纠正数据。
answer.en: No. Visual conditions expand, but action/state coverage may remain unchanged. Recovery, new routes and braking need corresponding trajectories or corrections.

blocks.en: datasets/scene-sample/ is a small image-and-label practice set for detector inference and short training. It is not enough to establish real-world generalization. Student checkpoints and logs belong in outputs/; do not copy them over the course files in models/.

title.zh: 来源与使用条款

blocks.zh: 机器人几何、社区策略和依赖组件分别保留各自的来源与许可条款，课程代码的许可并不覆盖第三方资产。分发修改版本前，请先查阅仓库中的 来源与许可说明。
blocks.en: Robot geometry, community policies, and dependencies retain their source terms. The course-code license does not override third-party asset licenses. Before redistributing changes, read the repository’s attribution and license notices.

title.zh: 故障排查

summary.zh: 从环境、文件和参数开始检查，保留失败输出，以便比较下一次运行。
summary.en: Check environment, files, and arguments first. Preserve failed outputs for comparison.

title.zh: 先收集基本信息

blocks.zh: 在课程仓库根目录的终端中运行下面的命令，完成本节操作。若命令包含输出目录，请使用尚不存在的新目录，以保留此前的结果。
blocks.en: Run the command below in a terminal at the repository root. If it specifies an output directory, use a new one to retain earlier results.

blocks.code:
python3 scripts/workshop.py doctor
python3 scripts/workshop.py verify-models
blocks.label: Terminal · Bash

blocks.zh: 出现问题时，记录第一条失败信息通常比反复启动完整训练更有价值。请检查命令是否在仓库根目录执行、当前 Python 是否来自锁定环境，以及所有模型校验是否通过。
blocks.en: The first failure is more useful than repeatedly launching a full training run. Check the repository directory, the selected runtime, and all model checks.

title.zh: 常见问题

zh: 使用 GPU 机器的桌面终端；检查 DISPLAY 和驱动，不要将纯命令行远程会话当作图形桌面。
查看日志是否仍在下载资源或编译；等待初始化，不要反复启动多个实例。
为新实验使用新的目录名，并保留上一次运行的结果。
先减少学生训练的环境数或检测 batch；不要同时运行多个仿真。
重新获取仓库中的原模型，确认没有覆盖固定文件。
自训练模型行走效果不佳
短训练仅用于体验流程，不保证策略表现。比较奖励、回合长度和独立测试表现；下一章继续使用固定模型。
机器人停止或没有进球
查看任务结果和观测有效性。信息不足时，停止可能是正确行为，但不能据此判定射门成功。
en: Use the GPU desktop terminal and check DISPLAY and the driver. A remote text shell is not a graphical desktop.
Check for downloads and compilation. Allow initialization and avoid starting duplicate instances.
Choose a new run name and preserve the previous result.
Reduce training environments or detector batch size. Avoid concurrent simulations.
Restore the repository model and check for accidental overwrites.
A short run teaches the workflow. Inspect reward, episode length, and evaluation. Continue with fixed models.
Robot stops or does not score
Inspect the task report and observation validity. Stopping can be appropriate when information is missing; it is not a goal.

title.zh: 查看一次运行

blocks.zh: 在课程仓库根目录的终端中运行下面的命令，完成本节操作。若命令包含输出目录，请使用尚不存在的新目录，以保留此前的结果。
blocks.en: Run the command below in a terminal at the repository root. If it specifies an output directory, use a new one to retain earlier results.

blocks.zh: 提交问题时，请附上运行命令、随机种子、环境检查结果和第一条报错信息。仅写“成功”或“失败”不足以定位问题，同时不要发送账户密码或访问令牌。
blocks.en: When reporting an issue, include the command, seed, environment report, and first error. A success/failure label alone is not enough. Do not include passwords or access tokens.

title.zh: 继续学习与参考资料

summary.zh: 按课程主题查阅官方源码、文档和论文。
summary.en: Find official source code, documentation, and papers by topic.

title.zh: 机器人与仿真

blocks.zh: 建议先从任务配置入手，理解观测、动作和奖励，再进一步研究物理引擎与传感器接口。这里使用的是固定版本，而官方文档可能已经介绍更新版本，因此比较参数前必须先核对版本。
blocks.en: Begin with task observations, actions, and rewards, then explore physics and sensors. Course commands target fixed versions; current documentation may describe newer versions. Check the version before applying changes.

title.zh: 建议的延伸练习

zh: 调整第三章的训练预算，并在相同的独立测试种子上比较表现。
比较第六章的两种射门方式：哪些失败来自观察，哪些来自动作与衔接？
根据第七章的示范数据流程，列出 Microduck 与 SO-101 的共同步骤和不同动作接口。
用第九章的组合计数器规划陌生房间评测，说明哪些条件用于训练、哪些留作测试。
en: Vary the Chapter 3 training budget and compare on the same held-out seeds.
Compare the two Chapter 6 modes: which failures concern observation, action or handoff?
Use Chapter 7 to identify shared data-workflow steps and different action interfaces for Microduck and SO-101.
Use the Chapter 9 counter to plan held-out room evaluation and separate training from test conditions.
